title: Coming Soon: Skibora, Boraclear & Borbact Topical Skin Creams
author: Vitborah Product Launch Desk
summary: Vitborah Pharmaceuticals prepares to introduce three NAFDAC-registered 30g topical creams—Skibora, Boraclear, and Borbact—designed for inflamed and mixed skin infections. Advance allocation requests are open ahead of arrival.
body: Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Limited is expanding its therapeutic portfolio with three upcoming dermatological creams: Boraclear (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102228), Borbact (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102229), and Skibora (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102230). These formulations have not arrived in our central warehouse yet and are currently in pre-arrival staging.

Boraclear combines Ketoconazole, Clobetasol Propionate, Neomycin Sulfate, and Vitamin-E in a 10 × 30 g presentation for the topical treatment of inflamed, mixed skin infections involving fungi and bacteria such as stubborn ringworm, fungal dermatitis, or infected eczema.

Borbact pairs Clotrimazole, Betamethasone Dipropionate, and Neomycin Sulfate (12 × 30 g pack) for inflamed skin infections complicated by mixed fungal and bacterial organisms such as infected ringworm, jock itch, or eczema.

Skibora delivers Clobetasol Propionate and Clotrimazole in 10 × 30 g packs for short-term topical relief of stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections such as severe tinea, athlete's foot, or fungal dermatitis accompanied by intense itching and redness.
Licensed pharmacies, clinics, and wholesale distributors can register advance pre-arrival inquiries through our procurement desk to be notified immediately upon stock release.

title: Now Selling: Augborah-625 & Artesunate IV/IM 60mg and 120mg Stocks Live
author: Commercial & Hospital Supply Desk
summary: Freshly stocked and available for immediate dispatch: Augborah-625 (2 × 7 tablets) alongside Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 60mg and 120mg for hospital IV/IM administration.
body: Healthcare facilities, registered pharmacies, and regional sub-distributors can now place direct orders for our newly stocked antibacterial and parenteral antimalarial arrivals at our Ibeju-Lekki headquarters and nationwide depots.

Augborah-625 (Amoxicillin & Potassium Clavulanate Tablets BP, NAFDAC Reg. No.: B4-5771) is now selling in sealed 2 × 7 tablet cartons for reliable oral beta-lactamase-protected antibacterial prescribing.

Alongside Augborah-625, Vitborah Artesunate for Injection is stocked in both 60 mg (N.A.F.D.A.C. Reg. No.: A4-100229) and 120 mg (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-101987) presentations formulated specifically for intravenous and intramuscular clinical use.
Orders placed through any of our eight regional branches receive priority cold-chain and batch-verified dispatch.

title: Pharmacy & Hospital Flash Sale: Seasonal Pricing on Core Therapeutics
author: Trade & Institutional Sales
summary: Time-limited institutional and wholesale flash pricing is live across selected Vitborah antibiotics, IV/IM artesunate vials, and fast-moving pharmacy formulations.
body: Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Limited is running a dedicated institutional and wholesale pharmacy flash sale across key therapeutic lines to help healthcare providers maintain uninterrupted patient care at optimized procurement costs.

Featured flash-sale allocations include volume tiers on Augborah-625 Tablets, Boraflox 500 Ciprofloxacin (updated pack release), Boracef Ceftriaxone 1g IV vials, and Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 60mg and 120mg.

Hospital purchasing departments, community pharmacy chains, and licensed wholesalers across Lagos, Abuja, Kaduna, Onitsha, and Aba can lock in flash-sale carton rates while current promotional stock lasts.
Contact our trade desk directly via our Contact page or your regional Vitborah depot representative to confirm current tier availability and dispatch scheduling.

title: Pre-Arrival Spotlight: Skibora Dual-Action Cream (Clobetasol + Clotrimazole)
author: Vitborah Product Launch Desk
summary: Scheduled for upcoming arrival: Skibora 30g Cream (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102230) targets stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections with intense itching and redness.
body: Ahead of our upcoming dermatological shipment, Vitborah highlights Skibora Cream (Clobetasol Propionate & Clotrimazole Cream, NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102230).

Supplied in 10 × 30 g carton packs (30 g individual tubes), Skibora is formulated for short-term topical relief of stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections such as severe tinea/ringworm, athlete's foot, or fungal dermatitis accompanied by intense itching and redness.
Skibora has not arrived in warehouse stock yet. Pharmacies and wholesale partners can inspect the full product record online and register for arrival alerts.

title: Pre-Arrival Spotlight: Borbact Cream for Mixed Fungal & Bacterial Skin Care
author: Vitborah Product Launch Desk
summary: Arriving soon at Vitborah depots: Borbact 30g Cream (NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102229) combining Clotrimazole, Betamethasone Dipropionate, and Neomycin Sulfate.
body: Borbact Cream (12 × 30 g pack, NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-102229) is part of Vitborah's upcoming skin and topical care rollout and is currently awaiting warehouse arrival.

Formulated with Clotrimazole, Betamethasone Dipropionate, and Neomycin Sulfate, Borbact addresses inflamed skin infections complicated by mixed fungal and bacterial organisms—including infected ringworm, jock itch, or eczema—while helping calm redness, swelling, and itching.
Distributors seeking early regional allocation upon shipment arrival are invited to reach out to the Vitborah procurement desk.

title: Now Selling: Venita Eye/Ear Drops & Venicol Ophthalmic Solution in 10mL Packs
author: Commercial & Hospital Supply Desk
summary: Expanding Vitborah's ophthalmic and otic care range: sterile 10 mL Venita Gentamicin 0.3% w/v Eye/Ear Drops and Venicol Chloramphenicol 0.5% w/v Eye Drops are now selling nationwide.
body: Joining Vitborah Timolol Eye Drops 0.5% in our specialized eye and ear care portfolio, Venita Gentamicin Eye/Ear Drops 0.3% w/v and Venicol Chloramphenicol Ophthalmic Solution USP 0.5% w/v are now actively stocked and shipping to pharmacies and eye clinics.

Venita (10 mL) delivers aminoglycoside antibiotic care for superficial bacterial infections of the eye—such as bacterial conjunctivitis or corneal ulcers—as well as outer ear canal infections (otitis externa).
Venicol (10 mL) provides broad-spectrum Chloramphenicol 0.5% w/v ophthalmic coverage in sterile clinical dropper packaging.
Also newly active in wholesale ordering is Vitborah Tramadol Capsules BP 100 mg (10 × 10 pack, NAFDAC Reg. No.: A4-101132) for licensed institutional pain management.

title: Flash Sale Bundle: Wholesale Incentives on Eye Drops & Essential Oral Packs
author: Trade & Institutional Sales
summary: Registered pharmacies ordering combined cartons of Boraflox 500, Venita Eye/Ear Drops, and Venicol Eye Drops qualify for priority flash-sale wholesale rebates.
body: As part of Vitborah's seasonal pharmacy restocking campaign, mixed-carton wholesale flash pricing is active for licensed community pharmacies and outpatient clinics.

Orders pairing newly packaged Boraflox 500 Ciprofloxacin Tablets (10 × 10 packs) with Venita Gentamicin 0.3% w/v Eye/Ear Drops and Venicol Chloramphenicol 0.5% w/v Eye Drops qualify for dedicated trade rebates.
Flash-sale allocations are fulfilled on a first-confirmed basis across Lagos, Abuja, Kaduna, Onitsha, and Aba hubs.
